notes.title: Road Map
notes.notes:
Polygon's Royale season 1 has launched and I would like to share the roadmap for the game and the features which will be included in season 2:

First of all, what is Polygon's Royale ?
Polygon's Royale is a Third/ First person shooter on a small island in a last man standing setting played as in other popular games.
A shrinkning ring is shrinking to a center of the map where then the end game will take place. The last survivor get a reward and you can customize your character with your rewards.

Season 1 features :
- Third/ first person shooter
- Different weapons (6 at the moment)
- Bots amount can be adjusted and replaced with zombies
- Different customizations (8 at the moment)
- a small island 
- different equipment to unlock weapon slots (Bags,Helmets, Vests)
- Hitbox statistics and user profile

Season 2 features :
- Drivable different vehicles 
- a big island
- towns, cities and a beautiful environment to explore (you can set the bots to 0 and you can just enjoy the world)
- Parachute start
- More weapons 
- More customizations
(- Maybe Multiplayer)

Thanks for your support and happy shooting!
